## Rule

Cross-line fill. Input (always **6×6**): a partial horizontal segment of **color 2** in exactly one row, and a partial vertical segment of **color 8** in exactly one column. Output extends BOTH lines fully across the grid: the color-2 row → all color 2, the color-8 column → all color 8, their **intersection cell → color 4**, everything else → background (color 0). Pad to 30×30 (top-left).

## Algorithm sketch

```
row2 = any color-2 in row r   (ReduceMax of ch2 over W)
col8 = any color-8 in col c   (ReduceMax of ch8 over H)
ch4 = row2 & col8 ; ch2 = row2 & ~col8 ; ch8 = ~row2 & col8 ; ch0 = ~row2 & ~col8
out[1,10,6,6] one-hot {0:ch0, 2:ch2, 4:ch4, 8:ch8, else 0} -> Pad to [1,10,30,30]
```

**ch0 is FORCED** (probed LIVE 2026-06-11): LIVE sets ch0=1 on all 25 background cells of the 6×6 active grid (padding cells all-zero). Decoder thresholds `out>0`, so byte-equal requires the full 10-channel one-hot incl the m0 background mask. You cannot drop ch0 / shrink the output to 4 channels.

## Cost analysis — LIVE 50 (memory 0) and the forced floor

LIVE `out[k,r,c] = C[c]·(R0·coeff[0,k] + R1·coeff[1,k])`, all fused in one Einsum read
straight off the raw `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot ⇒ **memory 0, cost = 50 params** =
`row_selector[2,10]`(20) + `col_selector[10]`(10) + `coeff[2,10]`(20). This is the
`ng_graph_cost_diff` charged structure; there is nothing else to shave.

**Forced-floor proof (WALL, cost 50):** the output is a rank-2 bilinear over the 2×2
(row-state × col-state) → {ch0,ch2,ch8,ch4} table. rank-1×rank-1 gives only 2 threshold
sign-classes < 4 needed channels (impossible). A rank-2 bilinear reading a 10-channel
input and writing a 10-channel output needs a [2,10] read + [2,10] output map; the −4·e_8
magnitude trick collapses the column factor to rank-1 [10] (cannot be smaller: needs a
nonzero non-8 baseline AND a ch8-specific flip, both dense-charged). = 20+20+10 = 50.
Every pairwise merge is infeasible (merge row_selector≡coeff proven: bg-row forces
t0·t2=0 ⇒ `base[ch0]=4|t0|²>0` on the 2-row ⇒ 2nd positive channel ⇒ threshold fails;
col_selector can't be shared — only it detects ch8). Materialized-intermediate routes
(v4=811, bool_concat=923) are ≫50. **Full proof: `hard_records/merge_and_sub50_floor.md`.**

## Don't-do log

- **Don't slice channel-only (axes=[1])** to save index params — the input is the full 30×30 canvas, so an un-cropped channel slice is [1,1,30,30] F32 = 3600 each (catastrophic). The spatial crop to 6×6 is what keeps x2/x8 at 144.
- **Don't drop ch0** / shrink the output to 4 channels — ch0=1 on bg is forced by LIVE; breaks byte-equal (and the true encoder, core.md ch0-drop trap).
- **Don't reduce-then-slice** (ReduceMax(input, axis) then Slice channel): reducing one spatial axis on all 10 channels = [1,10,6,1] F32 = 240 each = 480 > the 288 of slice-then-reduce.
- **Don't reach for fp16/bool on x2/x8** — Slice preserves input dtype (F32); casting the full input is 9000 B.
